title: Extraction of local auxiliary bits
statement: Let $V$ be a Boolean proof-checking system with proof length $m$, a finite verifier seed set $S$, and any number $r$ of query positions; let $K$ be a natural number. From a Boolean proof word of length $m+K|S|$ and a verifier seed, define a sign assignment on the $K$ auxiliary variables by reading, for each auxiliary position, the proof bit indexed by that position together with the seed’s index in $S$, after the first $m$ proof bits, and converting the bit to its sign in $\{ -1,1\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a Boolean PCPP system with proof length $m$ and $r$ query positions
a Boolean proof word of length $m+K|S|$
